title: Learn CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Docker and Go
description: Test, secure, containerize, and deploy a Go service through deterministic delivery pipelines.

lessons.title: Welcome to 'Learn CI/CD'
lessons.instruction: Continuous integration checks every proposed change; continuous delivery prepares every accepted change for release. Put the pipeline stages in an order that gives fast feedback before expensive build and deployment work.
lessons.solution:
format
test
lint
security
build
deploy
lessons.expected:
format
test
lint
security
build
deploy

lessons.title: Run Notely
lessons.instruction: Automation should begin from a known-good local build. Correct the Notely readiness message so this tiny baseline program produces the expected result before it enters CI.

lessons.title: Branches
lessons.instruction: Short-lived branches isolate unfinished work while keeping integration frequent. Configure the workflow filter so pull requests targeting main receive checks.
lessons.solution:
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

lessons.title: Pull Requests
lessons.instruction: A pull request creates a review boundary where automated status checks can block unsafe merges. Change the workflow event so it runs for pull requests instead of only manual dispatches.
lessons.solution: on: pull_request

lessons.title: Continuous Integration
lessons.instruction: CI keeps the main branch releasable by running the same fast checks for every change. Replace the deployment stage with the four checks that should gate a pull request.
lessons.solution:
format
test
lint
security

lessons.title: Breakdown of GitHub Actions
lessons.instruction: A workflow responds to an event, contains jobs, and each job runs ordered steps on a runner. Repair the nesting for one Linux job with one test step.
lessons.starter:
jobs:
  checks:
    steps:
      runs-on: ubuntu-latest
      - run: go test ./...
lessons.solution:
jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: go test ./...
lessons.expected:
jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: go test ./...

lessons.title: GitHub Actions
lessons.instruction: A Go CI job needs the repository contents and a Go toolchain before it can run tests. Complete the minimal workflow with checkout, setup-go, and the project-wide test command.
lessons.starter:
name: CI
on: pull_request
jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: go test
lessons.solution:
name: CI
on: pull_request
jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: stable
      - run: go test ./...
lessons.expected:
name: CI
on: pull_request
jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: stable
      - run: go test ./...

lessons.title: Running Tests
lessons.instruction: The package pattern ./... tells Go to test the current module and every package beneath it. Correct the command so CI does not silently test only the current package.
lessons.solution: go test ./...

lessons.title: Tests on CI
lessons.instruction: CI tests run on a clean machine, exposing undeclared dependencies and machine-specific assumptions. Replace the build-only step with the complete module test command.
lessons.solution:
- name: Test
  run: go test ./...

lessons.title: Code Coverage
lessons.instruction: Coverage reveals which statements tests execute, but high coverage does not prove good assertions. Generate a profile for every package, then print its function summary.
lessons.solution:
go test ./... -coverprofile=coverage.out
go tool cover -func=coverage.out

lessons.title: README Badge for Tests
lessons.instruction: A workflow badge reports the latest workflow result for a selected branch; it does not monitor the running application. Point both Markdown URLs at ci.yml on main.
lessons.solution: [![tests](https://github.com/acme/notely/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/acme/notely/actions/workflows/ci.yml?query=branch%3Amain)

lessons.title: Formatting
lessons.instruction: gofmt gives Go source one canonical layout, eliminating style arguments and noisy diffs. Correct the message and leave the solution in standard Go formatting.

lessons.title: Check Formatting
lessons.instruction: A CI formatting check should report drift and fail, not rewrite files that were already committed. Make the shell condition pass only when gofmt lists no files.
lessons.solution: test -z "$(gofmt -l .)"

lessons.title: Formatting CI
lessons.instruction: Run inexpensive formatting checks before tests and builds so developers receive faster feedback. Replace the mutating formatter step with a read-only gate.
lessons.solution:
- name: Check formatting
  run: test -z "$(gofmt -l .)"

lessons.title: Linting
lessons.instruction: Static analysis finds suspicious code that can compile and run, such as a formatting verb paired with the wrong value type. Fix the value passed to Printf so go vet and the output agree.

lessons.title: CI Linting
lessons.instruction: Go ships with go vet for suspicious constructs the compiler permits. Configure the CI step to analyze every package instead of only building the current directory.
lessons.solution:
- name: Lint
  run: go vet ./...

lessons.title: Linting Review
lessons.instruction: Formatting normalizes layout, tests verify behavior, and linting reports suspicious source patterns. Match each failure to the check that should catch it.
lessons.solution:
layout=format
wrong result=test
suspicious Printf=vet

lessons.title: Security Checks
lessons.instruction: govulncheck reports known vulnerabilities that are reachable from the module's code, which is more useful than checking dependency names alone. Scan every package in the current module.
lessons.solution: govulncheck ./...

lessons.title: CI Security
lessons.instruction: Automated vulnerability scanning prevents a known reachable issue from reaching main unnoticed. Use the dedicated Go vulnerability action in the CI steps.
lessons.starter:
- name: Security
  run: go list -m all
lessons.solution:
- name: Scan reachable vulnerabilities
  uses: golang/govulncheck-action@v1
lessons.expected:
- name: Scan reachable vulnerabilities
  uses: golang/govulncheck-action@v1

lessons.title: Fix Security Issues
lessons.instruction: After upgrading a vulnerable dependency, tidy the module, rerun tests, and scan again. Put the remediation commands in that verification order.
lessons.starter:
go test ./...
go get DEPENDENCY@FIXED_VERSION
govulncheck ./...
lessons.solution:
go get DEPENDENCY@FIXED_VERSION
go mod tidy
go test ./...
govulncheck ./...
lessons.expected:
go get DEPENDENCY@FIXED_VERSION
go mod tidy
go test ./...
govulncheck ./...

lessons.title: Security Review
lessons.instruction: Workflow tokens should receive only the permissions a job needs, and secrets must be referenced rather than printed or committed. Harden this job to read repository contents without exposing a credential.
lessons.solution:
permissions:
  contents: read
steps:
  - run: govulncheck ./...
lessons.expected:
permissions:
  contents: read
steps:
  - run: govulncheck ./...

lessons.title: Docker
lessons.instruction: A multi-stage Dockerfile builds the Go binary with a toolchain image and copies only the artifact into the runtime image. Complete the Linux build and run the resulting Notely binary.
lessons.starter:
FROM golang:1.24 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY . .
RUN go test ./...

FROM alpine:3.21
COPY --from=build /src/notely /notely
lessons.solution:
FROM golang:1.24 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build -o /notely .

FROM alpine:3.21
COPY --from=build /notely /notely
ENTRYPOINT ["/notely"]
lessons.expected:
FROM golang:1.24 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build -o /notely .

FROM alpine:3.21
COPY --from=build /notely /notely
ENTRYPOINT ["/notely"]

lessons.title: Continuous Deployment
lessons.instruction: Deployment should start only after required checks pass and only for accepted changes on main. Add the job dependency and branch condition to the deployment job.
lessons.solution:
deploy:
  needs: checks
  if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
  runs-on: ubuntu-latest
lessons.expected:
deploy:
  needs: checks
  if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
  runs-on: ubuntu-latest

lessons.title: Google Cloud Platform
lessons.instruction: Cloud resources belong to a project and region, while a service name identifies the deployed application. Fill the deployment configuration without adding credentials to the file.
lessons.solution:
PROJECT=notely-prod
REGION=us-central1
SERVICE=notely

lessons.title: Google Cloud SDK
lessons.instruction: The gcloud CLI must authenticate before selecting a project and region for later commands. Put the setup commands in a safe, repeatable order using environment-provided identity.
lessons.starter:
gcloud config set run/region $REGION
gcloud auth login
gcloud config set project $PROJECT
lessons.solution:
gcloud auth login
gcloud config set project $PROJECT
gcloud config set run/region $REGION
lessons.expected:
gcloud auth login
gcloud config set project $PROJECT
gcloud config set run/region $REGION

lessons.title: Google Artifact Registry
lessons.instruction: Artifact Registry image names include the registry region, project, repository, image, and tag. Construct the immutable Notely image reference for commit abc123.
lessons.solution: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/notely-prod/apps/notely:abc123

lessons.title: Automate Builds
lessons.instruction: A reproducible build tags the image with the source commit and pushes that exact artifact for deployment. Complete the Cloud Build step without embedding a credential.
lessons.starter:
- name: Build image
  run: docker build .
lessons.solution:
- name: Build and push image
  run: gcloud builds submit --tag us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/notely-prod/apps/notely:${{ github.sha }} .
lessons.expected:
- name: Build and push image
  run: gcloud builds submit --tag us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/notely-prod/apps/notely:${{ github.sha }} .

lessons.title: Google Cloud Run
lessons.instruction: Cloud Run supplies the listening port through the PORT environment variable, so a container must not assume its development port. Make the program print the address derived from PORT.

lessons.title: Cloud Run Review
lessons.instruction: A Cloud Run revision combines an image with region, port, ingress, and scaling settings. Correct the review record for the public Notely service.
lessons.solution:
region=us-central1
port=8080
max-instances=4
ingress=all

lessons.title: Delete the Test
lessons.instruction: This cleanup removes the temporary sample Cloud Run service, not an automated test. Supply the explicit service and region so an unrelated resource cannot be targeted accidentally.
lessons.solution: gcloud run services delete notely-test --region us-central1 --quiet
lessons.expected: gcloud run services delete notely-test --region us-central1 --quiet

lessons.title: Cloud Run Custom
lessons.instruction: Deploy the application image from Artifact Registry as the Notely service and make the intended public access explicit. The command is checked locally and is never executed.
lessons.solution: gcloud run deploy notely --image us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/notely-prod/apps/notely:abc123 --region us-central1 --allow-unauthenticated --max-instances 4

lessons.title: Cloud Run Updates
lessons.instruction: Deploying a commit-tagged image creates a traceable revision and avoids ambiguity from mutable latest tags. Update the workflow step to release the image built for this commit.
lessons.starter:
- name: Deploy
  run: gcloud run deploy notely --image notely:latest
lessons.solution:
- name: Deploy revision
  run: gcloud run deploy notely --image us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/notely-prod/apps/notely:${{ github.sha }} --region us-central1
lessons.expected:
- name: Deploy revision
  run: gcloud run deploy notely --image us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/notely-prod/apps/notely:${{ github.sha }} --region us-central1

lessons.title: Turso
lessons.instruction: A managed libSQL database needs a connection URL and an authentication token. Keep both values in deployment secrets rather than source-controlled workflow text.
lessons.solution:
DATABASE_URL=${{ secrets.DATABASE_URL }}
DATABASE_AUTH_TOKEN=${{ secrets.DATABASE_AUTH_TOKEN }}

lessons.title: Migrations
lessons.instruction: Versioned migrations make schema changes reproducible and order-dependent. Arrange the files so the table exists before a column and index refer to it.
lessons.solution:
001_create_notes.sql
002_add_notes_body.sql
003_create_notes_index.sql

lessons.title: Migrate Automatically
lessons.instruction: Build first, migrate only after a usable artifact exists, then deploy code compatible with the new schema. Correct the deployment step order so a failed build cannot alter the database.
lessons.starter:
steps:
  - run: deploy
  - run: migrate
  - run: build
lessons.solution:
steps:
  - run: build
  - run: migrate
  - run: deploy
lessons.expected:
steps:
  - run: build
  - run: migrate
  - run: deploy

lessons.title: Using the DB
lessons.instruction: Database credentials belong in the service runtime environment, not inside the container image. Configure Cloud Run to obtain both values from named secrets; this command is validated but never executed.
lessons.starter: gcloud run services update notely --set-env-vars DATABASE_URL=secret
lessons.solution: gcloud run services update notely --set-secrets DATABASE_URL=database-url:latest,DATABASE_AUTH_TOKEN=database-token:latest --region us-central1
lessons.expected: gcloud run services update notely --set-secrets DATABASE_URL=database-url:latest,DATABASE_AUTH_TOKEN=database-token:latest --region us-central1

lessons.title: CI/CD Review
lessons.instruction: The finished pipeline gates pull requests, builds one traceable artifact after merge, migrates compatibly, and deploys that same artifact. Restore the complete stage order, including final resource cleanup for a local course run.
lessons.solution:
format
test
lint
security
build
migrate
deploy
cleanup
lessons.expected:
format
test
lint
security
build
migrate
deploy
cleanup
